digest.component_or_area: src/rebar codebase-wide comment and documentation rationalization
propositions: Six subsystem agents triaged 439 files in src/rebar to relocate ~2033 comment lines from code into appropriate destinations (tickets for history, ADRs for architecture, schema for contracts) leaving only proximate just-in-time context
Three files (event_append.py, _processors.py, signing.py) contain load-bearing comments documenting replay-compatibility and security invariants that cannot be safely relocated

Verified-stale comments found across six shards (deterministic floor mislabeled as P1-P9 vs P1-P11, stale Anthropic constraints, nonexistent module paths) must be corrected in place where they document live invariants
Each shard produced a do_not_move list protecting load-bearing blocks (external-API facts, anti-refactor warnings, pragmas) that must be preserved verbatim and recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md
Thirteen new ADRs (0062-0069) consolidate arguments currently restated 4-8 times across the codebase, with inline blocks reduced to citations after ADRs are committed

Net outcome across six shards is ~85 lines recovered (measured output, not target), achieved primarily through relocation to ADRs and citation consolidation rather than deletion, with all test suite and linting unchanged
